note: Shared cases for tools/catalog.py and src/render/validate.js. tests/test_vectors.py checks that the Python validator gives each expected list.

run-steps.name: run-steps
run-steps.description: An ordered list of one agent run. Each step has a unique id and a state in text. A button opens the detail or tool call. A new fill keeps an open or focused button for the same id. A polite status gives changes to existing steps after the first fill.

parts.name: announcement
parts.description: Polite status for changes to step states.

parts.name: details
parts.description: Control and technical details of a refusal.

parts.name: list
parts.description: Named ordered list of run steps.

parts.name: panel
parts.description: Panel opened by the step button.

parts.name: toggle
parts.description: Button that opens or closes step details.

plan.name: plan
plan.description: A named list of tasks in an agent plan. Each task has a unique id and shows its state as text. A polite status gives changes to existing tasks after the first fill.

parts.name: announcement
parts.description: Polite status for changes to task states.

parts.name: details
parts.description: Control and technical details of a refusal.

empty-state.name: empty-state
empty-state.description: A heading and short text for an empty result, with an optional action from the page.

skeleton.name: skeleton
skeleton.description: A named loading status with one to six lines that hold space for content.

badge.name: badge
badge.description: A short label with a tone. The text gives its meaning.

avatar.name: avatar
avatar.description: A name shown as one or two initials, with a question mark for a name with no letter.

breadcrumbs.name: breadcrumbs
breadcrumbs.description: A list of links to pages in the path.

date-time-field.name: date-time-field
date-time-field.description: A local date and time with a fixed time zone label.

loan-shelf.name: loan-shelf
loan-shelf.description: A shelf of loans and loan grids.
